question:
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must configure Embedded Event Manager to output a message to syslog when the Cisco IOS write memory CLI command runs. Which command completes the script?
event manager applet cli-match
  ______
  action 1.0 syslog msg "$_cli_msg Command Executed"
  set 2.0 _exit_status 1
options: event cli pattern "write memory.*" sync yes
event cli match "write memory.*" sync yes
event cli regex "write memory.*" sync yes
event cli command "write memory.*" sync yes
